newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dong Sung Pharm sets 28-for-100 rights.
newsitem.headline: Dong Sung Pharm sets 28-for-100 rights.

text.p: South Korea's Dong Sung Pharmaceutical Co Ltd said on Thursday it would offer a 28-for-100 rights issue in January to raise funds for facilities investment.
The issue will increase paid-in capital to 7.4 billion won from nearly 5.5 billion at present.

A Dong Sung statement said the company plans to issue 383,865 new common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of December 17 for rights.
The issue price will be set at a 25 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later.
Subscription is scheduled for January 13 and 14, with payment due by January 28.
Dong Sung shares closed down 200 won at 28,100 on Thursday.
